parsed.name: Narda 601 场强仪
parsed.description: Narda 601 是一类用于测量电磁场强度的场强仪/探头设备，可读出电场强度等场强数据，常用于射频与电磁环境测试、设备辐射评估以及实验室场强监测。
parsed.description_en: The Narda 601 is a field strength meter/probe used to measure electromagnetic field strength, including electric field intensity readings. It is commonly used for RF and electromagnetic environment testing, radiation assessment, and laboratory field monitoring.
